Different tasks and test sizes. Digits and letters measure image classification; words measure reading accuracy across 8,912 reference word tokens. Clean MNIST accuracy is separate from CAPTCHA accuracy. Download digit and CAPTCHA evaluation.

Word test details

67.89% word accuracy = 100% − word error rate. Word insertions, deletions and substitutions count as errors. Case and punctuation count too.

This is a transcription, not a correctness guarantee. The reader can add, omit or misread words. Full pages, multiple lines and other languages are not supported in this mode.

About the word reader & downloads

Words uses the pretrained TrOCR Small handwriting model, separately from our digit and letter CNNs. It was fine-tuned on English handwriting from IAM. Our small English handwriting comparison favored full-precision weights. It is not a general accuracy benchmark, and neither option was trained by this project.

Standard downloads about 65 MB of compact model weights; Full precision downloads about 250 MB of full-precision weights. Both come from Hugging Face, with Transformers.js and WebAssembly from jsDelivr. Downloads may be cached by your browser. Images and recognized text stay on your device; no recognition API or account is used. Internet access is required on first use; offline availability is not guaranteed.

This mode shows the prepared handwriting and original transcription. The CNN class scores and activation maps belong to Digits and Letters modes.
